_comment: Edge Functions that exist in the repository but are NOT deployed yet. Each needs an approved deploy; after it, run the manifest generator and remove the entry. The manifest guard fails for any undeployed function not listed here, and for any listed function that production already runs. "modified" lists DEPLOYED functions whose source has a reviewed, not-yet-deployed change: the guard skips only their index/bundle comparison and fails if one is listed that is not deployed.

fetch-v2-quote.reason: Fetch v2 quote boundary; held until iOS Build 148 clears review and Darren approves

fetch-v2-create.reason: Fetch v2 create boundary; held until iOS Build 148 clears review and Darren approves

fetch-v2-accept.reason: driver accepts a Fetch v2 job and the manual-capture hold is placed; held until iOS Build 148 clears review and Darren approves

fetch-v2-payment.reason: requester completes a Fetch v2 hold that needs 3DS or a new card; held until iOS Build 148 clears review and Darren approves

fetch-v2-driver.reason: driver hold refresh, release, agree cancellation, deliver (capture); held until iOS Build 148 clears review and Darren approves

fetch-v2-admin.reason: administrator Fetch v2 payment actions (Step 5) and driver verification review/decisions (Step 6, area "drivers"); held until iOS Build 148 clears review and Darren approves

fetch-v2-runner.reason: cron-only Fetch v2 sweeps (x-cron-secret): payments (Step 5) and driver-verification expiry/reminders/upload clean-up (Step 6), not scheduled; held until iOS Build 148 clears review and Darren approves

fetch-v2-driver-verification.reason: driver's own verification: status, vehicle, evidence upload to the private bucket via signed upload, own short-lived link; held until iOS Build 148 clears review and Darren approves

stripe-webhook.reason: adds the scoped Fetch v2 PaymentIntent hand-off (metadata.fetch_v2_request_id); v1 branches unchanged. Held until iOS Build 148 clears review and Darren approves; regenerate the manifest after the reviewed deploy.

become-driver.reason: application can only ever reach pending: logic moved to the audited fetch_v2_apply_driver (refuses suspended accounts, 18+ and restriction checks, vehicle changes re-verified); response shape kept for the existing apply forms. Needs migration 20261203000000 applied first. Held until iOS Build 148 clears review and Darren approves; regenerate the manifest after the reviewed deploy.
